schedule.title: Schedule menu
schedule.lockedLead: Define which days and times each menu appears on the public page, based on the business timezone.
schedule.lockedMessage: This feature is available on Pro or Premium plans.
schedule.intro: Define when each menu appears on the business page. The direct menu URL remains available if it is published. To keep it always visible: turn off “Schedule visibility” and save.
schedule.needBusiness: You need at least one business to schedule menus.
schedule.noMenus: This business has no menus yet.
schedule.outsideHours: Outside this schedule the menu is not listed on the business page, but it can still be opened via its direct link.
schedule.timeHint: If left empty, the menu is visible all day on the selected days.
schedule.dateRangeHint: If disabled, the schedule applies only by days and hours, regardless of the calendar date.
schedule.noSchedule: No schedule: if published, it always appears on the business page (within validity). Remember to save your changes.
